name: Avocado & egg toast
description: A little crunch, a creamy avocado, and a sunny start to the day.
steps: Toast the sourdough until golden and crisp.
Mash avocado with lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Fry eggs in a lightly oiled pan until the whites are set.
Spread avocado over toast, top with eggs and finish with chilli flakes.

name: Garden harvest bowl
description: A fresh, colourful bowl with a bright lemon dressing.
steps: Wash and dry the salad leaves.
Combine leaves, cucumber and tomatoes in a large bowl.
Whisk olive oil and lemon juice; season to taste.
Toss gently with the dressing and crumble feta over the top.

name: Slow Sunday tomato pasta
description: Sweet tomatoes, fragrant basil, and a generous tangle of pasta.
steps: Warm olive oil in a pan and gently cook garlic for one minute.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook spaghetti in salted water according to the package instructions. Reserve a cup of cooking water.
Toss pasta with sauce, loosening with a splash of cooking water. Finish with basil and Parmesan.

name: Berry breakfast pancakes
description: Fluffy little pancakes with berries and a drizzle of maple syrup.
steps: Whisk flour and baking powder together.
Beat egg with milk, then stir into the dry ingredients until just combined.
Spoon batter into a lightly greased pan over medium heat.
Flip when bubbles appear and cook for another minute. Serve with berries and maple syrup.

name: Chocolate afternoon shake
description: A rich cocoa treat, topped with softly whipped cream.
steps: Blend milk, ice cream and cocoa until smooth.
Drizzle chocolate syrup inside a chilled glass.
Pour in the shake and top with whipped cream. Serve immediately.

name: Maple iced latte
description: Your afternoon pause: mellow coffee, cold milk, and a hint of maple.
steps: Stir maple syrup into the cooled espresso.
Fill a tall glass with ice and pour in the milk.
Pour the coffee slowly over the milk, stir, and enjoy.
